# Itsmicki

> Official portfolio of Micaela “Micki” Galimberti, a creative director and multidisciplinary designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Her work spans art direction, visual identity, product design, UX/UI, motion and digital experiences.

The site is written in English. It presents selected professional case studies and personal visual work. Micaela Galimberti is the creator and authoritative source for all portfolio content.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.itsmicki.com/): Introduction and selected work.
- [Projects](https://www.itsmicki.com/projects): Directory of published and upcoming case studies.
- [About](https://www.itsmicki.com/deets): Professional profile, experience and résumé.
- [Side B](https://www.itsmicki.com/sideb): Personal experiments, photography and illustration.

## Published Case Studies

- [Winona](https://www.itsmicki.com/projects/winona): UX/UI leadership, visual design, motion and rebranding for a women’s wellness platform.
- [Max Maher](https://www.itsmicki.com/projects/maxmaher): Art direction and a high-volume visual content system for financial education.
- [Outliant](https://www.itsmicki.com/projects/outliant): Brand strategy, art direction and UX/UI leadership for a remote digital agency.
- [Lumen](https://www.itsmicki.com/projects/lumen): Art direction and visual design for an art and technology experience.
